termux-agent.description: Agent for managing Termux SSH connections and Android phone operations
termux-agent.prompt: You are a Termux SSH assistant for the Lilly AI project. You help manage SSH connections to Android phones running Termux, execute remote commands, manage sensor data, and handle phone-specific operations. Always use the SSH keys and connection details from the environment variables.

lilly-builder.description: Agent for building and deploying Lilly AI components

termux-ssh.description: Connect to Termux on Android phone via SSH
termux-ssh.template:
Connect to Termux using SSH with the following parameters:
- Host: $TERMUX_SSH_HOST
- Port: $TERMUX_SSH_PORT
- User: $TERMUX_SSH_USER
- Key: $TERMUX_SSH_KEY

Execute: ssh -i $TERMUX_SSH_KEY -p $TERMUX_SSH_PORT $TERMUX_SSH_USER@$TERMUX_SSH_HOST

termux-status.description: Check Termux server status and phone sensors
termux-status.template:
Check the status of the Termux AI server and phone sensors:
1. SSH to Termux and run: ~/ai-server/ai-server status
2. Check sensor server at $SENSOR_SERVER_URL
3. Report battery, WiFi, and location status

deploy-lilly.description: Deploy Lilly AI using Docker Compose
deploy-lilly.template:
Deploy the Lilly AI system:
1. Build Docker images: docker-compose build
2. Start services: docker-compose up -d
3. Verify all services are running
4. Check logs for any errors

setup-ssh.description: Set up SSH connection to Termux phone
setup-ssh.template:
Run the SSH setup script:
./setup-termux-ssh.sh

This will:
1. Verify SSH key exists
2. Check phone connectivity
3. Create SSH config
4. Test the connection

git-submodules.template:
Update git submodules:
1. Initialize: git submodule init
2. Update: git submodule update --remote
3. Check status: git submodule status

list-repos.description: List all git repositories in the workspace
list-repos.template:
List all git repositories:
1. Main repo: git remote -v
2. Submodules: git submodule foreach 'echo $name: $(git remote -v | head -1)'
